title: Activation Holds and eGift Delivery Options for Northgate Gift Cards and Merchandise Return Cards
content:
Every card in the Northgate Gift Cards and Merchandise Return Cards program has an activation method, which states how the card becomes usable, and an activation hold, which is the number of hours after purchase before the card can be used, kept as a fraud control. Digital cards are also delivered under a set delivery method, may be scheduled for later delivery up to a set number of calendar days ahead, and may or may not be resent to the same recipient address.

## Activation by card type

| Card type | How the card becomes usable | Hours after purchase before the card can be used |
|---|---|---|
| Northgate Gift Card | activated at the register | 0 |
| Northgate eGift Card | activated on delivery | 4 |
| Northgate Merchandise Return Card | activated on issue | 0 |
| Northgate Promotional Gift Card | activated on issue | 0 |
| Northgate Business Bulk Gift Card | activated when the bulk order is paid | 24 |
| Northgate Reloadable Gift Card | activated at the register | 0 |

## eGift delivery by card type

| Card type | How the eGift is delivered | Most calendar days ahead a delivery can be scheduled | eGift can be resent to the same recipient address |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Gift Card | not applicable, physical card | 0, not applicable | no |
| Northgate eGift Card | email or text message | 365 | yes |
| Northgate Merchandise Return Card | email | 0, not applicable | yes |
| Northgate Promotional Gift Card | email | 0, not applicable | yes |
| Northgate Business Bulk Gift Card | email | 90 | yes |
| Northgate Reloadable Gift Card | not applicable, physical card | 0, not applicable | no |

## Reading the tables

- A hold of 0 hours means the card can be used as soon as it is activated.
- A scheduling figure of 0 means scheduled delivery does not apply to that type; only the Northgate eGift Card (up to 365 calendar days ahead) and the Northgate Business Bulk Gift Card (up to 90 calendar days ahead) can have delivery scheduled.
- Resending is to the same recipient address; the tables give no other resend option.

## Illustrations (hypothetical times)

- A Northgate eGift Card purchased at 09:00 has a 4-hour hold, so it cannot be used before 13:00 that day.
- Northgate Business Bulk Gift Cards on an order purchased at 10:00 on one day cannot be used before 10:00 the following day, 24 hours later.
- A Northgate eGift Card delivery may be scheduled for the 365th calendar day ahead, but not the 366th.
